run_qemu_rnd_helper.cmd: QH_LOG=/tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log; QH_RC=/tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc; rm -f "$QH_RC"; echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_START"; ( qemu-rnd-helper >"$QH_LOG" 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "$rc" > "$QH_RC"; echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_EXIT_RC=$rc"; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "AUTOPILOT_FAIL: QEMU_RND_HELPER_EXIT_NONZERO rc=$rc"; tail -n 80 "$QH_LOG" | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_ERR: /'; fi ) & qh_pid=$!; echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_LAUNCHED pid=$qh_pid log=$QH_LOG rc_file=$QH_RC"; sleep 1; if ! kill -0 "$qh_pid" 2>/dev/null; then if [ -f "$QH_RC" ]; then rc=$(cat "$QH_RC"); echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_EARLY_EXIT rc=$rc"; fi; fi

emit_qemu_bootstrap_diag.cmd: echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_BOOTSTRAP_DIAG_BEGIN'; if pgrep -x qemu-rnd-helper >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RUNNING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_NOT_RUNNING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; fi; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc ]; then echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RC_EARLY=$(cat /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc)"; fi; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log ]; then tail -n 60 /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_BOOTSTRAP: /'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_LOG_MISSING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; fi; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_BOOTSTRAP_DIAG_END'

emit_no_mmio_rpc_activity_fail.cmd: echo 'AUTOPILOT_FAIL: VIO_TRACE_NO_MMIO_RPC_ACTIVITY_BEFORE_DUMP_WINDOW'; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: NO_ACTIVITY_DIAG_BEGIN'; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc ]; then rc=$(cat /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc); echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RC_FILE rc=$rc"; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RC_FILE missing'; fi; if pgrep -x qemu-rnd-helper >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_STILL_RUNNING'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_NOT_RUNNING'; fi; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log ]; then tail -n 80 /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_LOG: /'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_LOG_MISSING_ON_TIMEOUT'; fi; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: NO_ACTIVITY_DIAG_END'
